statement: Historical Linux v6.1 hid-sony performs firmware GET 0xA3/49 bytes and reads hardware/firmware at 35/41; unlike later hid-playstation, a failed version request aborts DS4 initialization. A virtual implementation targeting this historical driver must provide a compatible response.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-sony.c 1893–1915, 2851–2863. Version-specific host requirement; stub data content/fidelity remains unverified.
